Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Unless alone, may place Trench in Used Pile to make an [Episode I] starship here immune to attrition for remainder of turn. While at opponent's system, their starships deploy +1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 February 2023): Players Committee card image, 20 February 2023: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-admiraltrench.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8c98fe0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/admiraltrench.png Holotable commit 8c98fe0 “Set 12 Remastered”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Unless alone, may place Trench in Used Pile to make an [Episode I] starship here immune to attrition for remainder of turn. While at opponent's system, their starships deploy +1 here.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
